SQLReferenceRecord deliberately has no GrantSHA256. It binds exact original authority/grant/revision/epoch/config tuple. SQLGrant.References lists exactly five purpose/raw canonical reference-record SHA256 pairs in binary purpose order; SQLGrant.ReferenceSetSHA256 hashes canonical JSON of that array. Never hash credentials, signatures or SQL projections in place of those record bytes.

SQLHead selects current_grant_id/current_grant_revision/permission_epoch. This version supports initial HeadRevision=RecordRevision=PermissionEpoch=1 active install, then signed HeadRevision+1 revoked state with all other ORIGINAL fields/windows unchanged. No reactivation, rotation or fresh epoch is implemented by this batch; the old D document's possible replacement-epoch language is not permission to add one.
